exposure: Group Counseling and Shared Decision-Making (GCSDM) curriculum session
outcome: confidence in mode of birth decision-making
cohort: The study included 10 Haitian Creole-speaking women in Massachusetts with a history of cesarean.
finding: The GCSDM session was accepted by Haitian Creole-speaking women with a history of cesarean and appeared feasible and effective in improving mode of birth decision-making.
mod_finding: After the GCSDM session, there was a 50% increase in women planning to labor after cesarean and 90% stated the session provided enough information for confident mode of birth decisions.
